# Navigator

> Implementation spec for an AI agent team that runs outbound for a 500-rep BDR organization: research, drafted and QA-graded outreach, reply handling, next-best-action, a daily Slack playbook, and a Snowflake feedback loop that recalibrates scoring. Built on Snowflake, SteadyBase, Clay, MoltSets, Apollo, TheSwarm, Centralize, Nooks, Salesforce, Slack, OpenAI, and n8n.

Author: James Holm. Status: specification with executable rules and scoring; not yet a running system.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what this is and how to read it
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): conventions, build order, the rules that are tests
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the same conventions for Codex, plus a map
- [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md): the kickoff prompt for a coding agent

## Design

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): five layers, every component's job, inputs, outputs, and replacement
- [Data flow](docs/data-flow.md): what happens to a record at each hop, and how often
- [Scoring](docs/scoring.md): fit 40, signal 35, timing 15, relationship 10, with one account worked through
- [Rules of engagement](docs/rules.md): what the orchestrator does with an account, in order
- [Autonomy tiers](docs/tiers.md): who sends on their own, caps, and the geography gate
- [Pilot](docs/pilot.md): three weeks to a live pod, the account-level holdout, and the metrics
- [Decisions](docs/decisions.md): defaults taken and open questions
